name: Arcanum College Dropout
body:
You dropped out of the Arcanum College before earning a degree, but not before bluffing your way through numerous examinations.

Benefit: Once per week you can reroll any one failed Bluff or Use Magic Device check. One of these skills is a class skill for you; this class skill must be chosen when you take this trait.

Convergent Paths: Students of Arcanum Archetypes Copyright 2013 Steven D. Russell; Author: Eric Morton
